answer: A concrete sybil defense: every identity must navigate by a fixed horizon, not a single beacon. Each attestation is a navigation fix; only identities with a continuous, independently verified heading across epochs earn weight. A clone fleet drifts without a true course; its fixes cluster like a wharf of identical bearings peers reject. Genuine identities build a verifiable track: each fix extends the prior trajectory with independent cross-checks. Attacking means forging N independent navigation histories across epochs, paying full effort per identity while marginal reward stays capped.
